enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed, air conditioner keeping the room cool through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Adjust blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up on bed. Stand up and walk to bathroom. Turn on light and tap. Brush teeth and wash face. Turn off tap. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with kettle-boiled water, toast and fruit
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle and turn on. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and fruit. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Pour hot water into cup. Take toast and place on plate. Wash and cut fruit. Place fruit on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink water. Stand up and clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running the washing machine, then moving clothes to the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry hamper. Sort clothes into piles. Pick up pile of light clothes. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Close washing machine. Add detergent. Close detergent drawer. Set washing machine cycle. Press start button. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Transfer to dryer. Close dryer door. Set dryer cycle. Press start button.

enriched_activities.activity: Going out early for grocery shopping before the heat peaks
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Pick up reusable bags. Open door. Step out. Lock door. Walk to store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select fruits. Select vegetables. Walk to dairy section. Select milk. Select eggs. Walk to bakery. Select bread. Walk to checkout. Wait in line. Place items on conveyor. Pay. Receive receipt. Bag items. Walk out. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries in the refrigerator and organizing the pantry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take items from bags. Place items in refrigerator. Close refrigerator. Open pantry. Place items in pantry. Close pantry. Fold bags. Put bags away. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa browsing the computer and watching TV with the space heater off and fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Turn off space heater. Sit on sofa. Pick up computer. Open computer. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channels. Browse on computer. Type. Click. Scroll. Watch TV. Adjust fan speed. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get water. Return. Sit down. Continue browsing.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light lunch on the induction cooker and eating it at the table
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Carry plate to table. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Wash plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisurely reading and watching TV while staying out of the midday heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Look up at TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Continue reading. Turn page. Adjust sitting position. Put down book. Pick up computer. Browse.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and taking a nap in the air-conditioned bedroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Wake up. Sit up. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing online continuing-education study for work on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Navigate to course. Watch video. Take notes. Pause video. Rewind. Play. Read article. Scroll. Type notes. Save notes. Close browser. Log out. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Light indoor exercise and stretching to avoid the extreme outdoor heat
enriched_activities.desc: Roll out exercise mat. Stand on mat. Stretch arms. Bend forward. Touch toes. Stand up. Stretch legs. Do squats. Do lunges. Do jumping jacks. Do push-ups. Do sit-ups. Stretch back. Lie on back. Bend knees. Twist. Stand up. Roll up mat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into fresh clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Put on fresh clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Preheat oven. Place ingredients on baking sheet. Put in oven. Set timer. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Take baking sheet out of oven. Turn off oven. Place food on plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Carry plates to table. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut food. Eat. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Carry plates to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load glasses. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing the game console, cooling off with the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Check phone. Resume game. Adjust fan. Continue playing. Turn off game console. Put down controller. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time washing up and skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse. Pat dry. Apply toner. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, checking the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Open phone. Check messages. Browse. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner on for the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to other side. Adjust blanket. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
